title: Frontend Revision: Recover, Reason, Build
scope: Revision-first JavaScript and browser core, with independently selectable React, Angular and internals branches. Not a claim of exhaustive frontend expertise.

units.title: Recover the JavaScript execution model
units.outcome: Explain and predict binding, value and object-lifetime behavior without a trivia marathon.

units.title: Async results, errors and execution order
units.outcome: Control async work and explain observable ordering, error propagation and stale-result behavior.

units.title: Browser interactions and user-visible correctness
units.outcome: Connect JavaScript to event ownership, network boundaries and an observable UI symptom.

units.title: React state ownership and effect lifetimes
units.outcome: Reason about UI state, identity and synchronization rather than recite Hook definitions.

units.title: React asynchronous UI, rendering boundaries and diagnosis
units.outcome: Explain asynchronous and server/client behavior in the actual project environment.

units.title: React internals when they answer a real question
units.outcome: Use a narrow internal model to explain an observed scheduling or identity behavior.

units.title: Angular reactive state and dependency lifetimes
units.outcome: Connect signal dependencies, injector ownership and async lifetime to the displayed UI.

units.title: Angular features, navigation and diagnostic work
units.outcome: Design a feature whose form, requests, routes and service lifetimes stay coherent.
